

# logonui.exe is all Rust (logonui-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/logonui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# logonui.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/logonui-rust/src/logonui/logonui.rs)
# NT5design.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/logonui-rust/src/logonui/NT5design.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(logonui_res OBJECT logonui.rc)
target_compile_definitions(logonui_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(logonui_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(logonui logonui-cargo logonui.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE logonui-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS logonui_res)
